description_en: Queries all users of a cluster
description_zh: 调用ListUsers查询集群用户列表
name: ListUsers

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the page to return.

Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码。

起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的条数。取值范围：1~50

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries

AddTime.description_en: The time when the user was created

Group.description_en:
The name of the permission group. Valid values:

users: an ordinary permission group. It is applicable to ordinary users that need only to submit and debug jobs.
wheel: a sudo permission group. It is applicable to the administrator who needs to manage the cluster. In addition to submitting and debugging jobs, users who have sudo permissions can run sudo commands to install software and restart nodes
Group.description_zh:
用户组。可能值：

users：普通权限组，适用于只有提交、调试作业需求的普通用户。
wheel：sudo权限组，适用于需要管理集群的管理员，除提交、调试作业外，还可以执行sudo命令进行安装软件、重启节点等操作
